explanation: Peaks at the GO step: about 10 when the previous trial was unrewarded and about 8 when it was rewarded in early trials (before ~40), drifting down to about 7 and 5 respectively late in the episode (trials 70-100). D2 is always 0-1, and D1 is usually 1-3 but climbs to 4-8 after two or more unrewarded trials in a row.
